Name: order_date
Meaning: Date of the sale
Notes: Sales are recorded on about 123 days per year, in blocks of consecutive weekdays

Name: order_year
Meaning: Year of the sale
Notes: 2018 = Jan to 20 Jul only

Name: order_quarter
Meaning: Quarter of the sale (1–4)

Name: order_month
Meaning: Month of the sale (first day of the month)
Notes: Use for monthly trend charts

Name: retailer_code
Meaning: ID of the retailer (customer)
Notes: Key to the retailers table

Name: retailer_name
Meaning: Name of the retailer

Name: retailer_type
Meaning: Store type of the retailer
Notes: 8 types, e.g. Outdoors Shop, Golf Shop

Name: country
Meaning: Country of the retailer
Notes: 21 countries

Name: product_number
Meaning: ID of the product
Notes: Key to the products table

Name: product_name
Meaning: Name of the product
Notes: Some names exist in several colours (different product numbers)

Name: product_line
Meaning: Product line
Notes: 5 lines

Name: product_type
Meaning: Product type
Notes: 21 types

Name: brand
Meaning: Brand of the product (supplier)
Notes: 26 brands

Name: order_method
Meaning: How the order was placed
Notes: 7 methods used; codes 8–12 ('Other') never used

Name: quantity
Meaning: Number of items in the order line

Name: unit_price
Meaning: Normal price per item on the day of the sale
Notes: Price before discount

Name: unit_sale_price
Meaning: Price per item the customer actually paid
Notes: After discount; 0 = given away

Name: unit_cost
Meaning: Cost per item for GoOutside
Notes: One value per product (no cost history)

Name: regular_price
Meaning: Regular retail price per item
Notes: One value per product; for 80 products with a price change this price was never actually charged

Name: revenue
Meaning: Money received for the order line

Name: cost
Meaning: Cost of the goods in the order line

Name: profit
Meaning: Actual (realised) profit of the order line
Notes: Estimate: unit cost exists only once per product

Name: discount_value
Meaning: Money given away as discount

Name: is_discounted
Meaning: TRUE if sold below the normal price
Notes: 25.3% of order lines

Name: is_free
Meaning: TRUE if the product was given away
Notes: 524 order lines

Name: is_loss
Meaning: TRUE if sold below cost
Notes: 613 order lines (includes the free ones)

Name: loss_category
Meaning: Label: Given away / Sold below cost / Profitable
Notes: Defined once in the warehouse, used by Sheets and Looker Studio

Name: Total sales
Meaning: Sum of all revenue

Name: Profit
Meaning: Actual realised profit
Notes: 527.7 M; confirmed with instructor as the profit KPI

Name: Margin %
Meaning: Share of revenue that is profit
Notes: Weighted, never an average of row margins; about 42% overall

Name: Margin at regular price
Meaning: Profit per item if sold at the regular price
Notes: Per product; used for product comparison and pricing

Name: Discount %
Meaning: Share of the full price given away
Notes: 5.0% overall

Name: Regional sales
Meaning: Revenue per country

Name: Active retailers
Meaning: Retailers with at least one sale
How it is calculated / where it comes fr: COUNT DISTINCT retailer_code in the sales
Notes: 289 of 562 listed retailers

Name: Brands (suppliers)
Meaning: Brands with at least one sale
How it is calculated / where it comes fr: COUNT DISTINCT brand in the sales

Name: Order lines
Meaning: Number of rows in the sales data
Notes: Used as 'number of orders' because there is no order ID

Name: Year-over-year growth
Meaning: Change compared with the previous year
Notes: Compare the same period (1 Jan – 20 Jul) because 2018 is partial

Name: No order ID
Meaning: One row = one retailer × product × order method × day
Notes: Order lines are counted instead of orders

Name: 2018 is partial
Meaning: Data ends on 20 Jul 2018
Notes: Label 2018 as Jan–Jul; compare same periods

Name: Duplicate rows
Meaning: 802 exact duplicate rows (0.5% of rows, 0.09% of revenue)
Notes: Kept as genuine repeat orders; removing them changes no finding

Name: Inactive retailers
Meaning: 273 of 562 listed retailers never ordered
Notes: Includes all 30 Equipment Rental Stores

Name: Unused order methods
Meaning: Codes 8–12 ('Other') never appear in sales
Notes: Left out of charts

Name: Unsold products
Meaning: 30 of 274 products were never sold
Notes: Open question for the product team

Name: Single unit cost
Meaning: Cost exists once per product, prices changed over time
Notes: Profit is an estimate

Name: Free and below-cost sales
Meaning: 613 order lines sold below cost, loss −1.06 M
Notes: 92% of the loss from products given away at price 0

Name: No personnel costs
Meaning: Staff cost per order method is not in the data
Notes: Entered by the user in the Channel calculator

Meaning: Profit and margin per product line and year, two charts
